Title: fast-copy: Stack exhaustion in fast-copy when copying deeply-nested values
Description: `fast-copy` traverses values recursively with no bound on depth. Copying a sufficiently deeply-nested value exhausts the JavaScript call stack and throws a native `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded` from inside the library.
AffectedVersions: All versions before 2.2.0, all versions starting from 3.0.0 before 3.1.0, all versions starting from 4.0.0 before 4.1.0
NotImpacted: All versions starting from 2.2.0 before 3.0.0, all versions starting from 3.1.0 before 4.0.0, all versions starting from 4.1.0
